# LUP - Lund University Publications

> Institutional open-access repository for Lund University research publications, student theses, and academic output with comprehensive statistics and search capabilities.

LUP (Lund University Publications) is the official digital repository for Lund University, serving as a centralized platform for accessing peer-reviewed research, student papers, and institutional publications across multiple departments and faculties including LTH (Faculty of Engineering), LUSEM (School of Economics and Management), and specialized research institutes.

## Key Topics

- Lund University
- LUP (Lund University Publications)
- Open Access

- LUSEM (School of Economics and Management)
- IIIEE (International Institute for Industrial Environmental Economics)

## Repository Core

- [LUP Student Papers](https://lup.lub.lu.se/student-papers): Institutional repository for Lund University student theses and master papers (LUP-SP)

## Statistics & Analytics

- [LUP Statistics](https://lup.lub.lu.se/lupStat): Publication metrics, download analytics, and repository statistics for Lund University
